name: lower-third
label: Who is talking: a name and one line, low in the frame, on its own plate so it reads over any footage

variant.label: plate = a paper plate with an accent edge, dark = an ink plate, tag = a name chip with the line written under it

out.label: edge = leave by its edge at out_at, cut = hold to the end

out_at.label: edge: when it leaves (blank = 0.4 s before the end)
